name: Aircall

output.one_liner: Aircall offers a REST API, webhooks, and an SDK to build voice, messaging, and AI‑driven integrations.
output.access_note: API keys (API ID and token) can be generated from the Aircall Dashboard by any user, without an approval flow.

evidence.quote: Aircall supports two ways to authenticate with the REST API: Basic Authentication and OAuth.
Open your Aircall Dashboard > Integrations > API keys… Aircall will generate two strings: an `API ID` and an `API token`.
Connect Aircall to any business tool using our REST API and webhooks.
Build MCP‑compliant integrations for Aircall's AI Virtual Agent.
